title: Fix build errors and Tailwind version conflicts across monorepo
body:
Multiple packages failed to build due to tsconfig constraints and missing Vite externals. The CRM example app had Tailwind CSS version conflicts (v3 vs v4) causing PostCSS errors during bundling.

## Package Build Fixes

- **data-objectstack**: Removed `rootDir` constraint from tsconfig - was blocking DTS generation when importing workspace dependencies
- **layout, fields**: Added `@object-ui/react` (and `@object-ui/core` for fields) to Vite `external` array - Rollup couldn't resolve these imports during library bundling
- **core/adapters**: Commented out export for `ObjectStackAdapter` - implementation moved to `@object-ui/data-objectstack` package

## CRM App Tailwind Migration

Upgraded from Tailwind v3 → v4 to match component library:

```diff
- @tailwind base;
- @tailwind components;
- @tailwind utilities;
+ @import 'tailwindcss';

  @layer base {
    * {
-     @apply border-border;
+     border-color: hsl(var(--border));
    }
  }
```

Removed obsolete `tailwind.config.js` and `postcss.config.js`. Updated package.json to `tailwindcss@^4.1.18`.

## TypeScript Cleanup

- Removed unused imports (`useEffect`, `useMemo`, `Link`, `useLocation`, `useRenderer`)
- Fixed dashboard widget layouts - added required `x` and `y` coordinates:
  ```typescript
  layout: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 1, h: 1 }  // was: { w: 1, h: 1 }
  ```
- Improved CSS selector specificity (`*[class*="border"]` vs universal `*`)
- Added CSS variable fallback values for resilience

All 24 packages now build cleanly. CRM app dev server starts without errors.
